title: In-run capture
hook: **WIP:** weaken a wild demon in a run and attempt to **catch** it — a hunt intake beside the altar and wild joins.

blindSpots.meaning: Not finished. You should not expect a reliable capture button on every lawn yet.
Pressure a target in play, then attempt to add it as a specimen — not an altar pull.
A demon you meet in a run that is not already on your roster.
Design allows a small slice of species as lawn finds (never legendaries forever gated that way), with web paths so web-only play can still finish milestones.

alsoTrue: Altar and [wild joins](wild-joins) already grow the roster without capture.
Vision ecology (raids, blood moons) is separate — see the creatures pillar.

sections.title: What it will feel like
paras: Fight or pressure a target on the lawn or in a delve.
Attempt capture when the window opens — success adds a specimen.
diagram: meet wild target  ->  weaken / pressure  ->  capture attempt  ->  specimen

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Play lawn and expeditions with the intakes that already ship.
Treat missing capture prompts as unfinished work, not a broken save.

sections.title: Design guardrails
paras: No legendary forever locked behind capture-only.
Web-only players still need a path to finish milestones.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Use the altar and wild joins to grow the roster now.
When capture UI appears in a build, follow on-screen pressure and attempt rules.
Do not plan a legendary-only-from-capture collection route.
doNote: Roster category intakes end here for now. Power next: [Dave’s level](dave-level).

mixUps.q: Why can’t I capture on this lawn?
mixUps.a: Capture is WIP — absence is expected.

mixUps.q: Is capture the same as wild join?
mixUps.a: No. Wild joins come from expedition reports; capture is in-run pressure.
No. Design forbids gating legendaries forever this way.

mixUps.q: Does capture spend souls like the altar?
mixUps.a: Do not assume altar pricing. When it ships, trust the attempt UI.
